name: When should I call a professional for hidden mold inspection?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for hidden mold inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional for hidden mold inspection if you detect a persistent musty odor but cannot locate the source, or if you or your family members experience unexplained or worsening allergy-like symptoms when at home. It's also advisable after any water damage event, such as a leak or flood, even if you think it was fully dried. Professionals have the tools and expertise to safely identify hidden mold, assess the extent of the problem, and provide a remediation plan, preventing further spread and potential health risks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for hidden mold inspection if you smell mold but can't see it, experience unexplained health issues, or after any water damage event.
